authorship: Written for this project AFTER the follow-up sweep. Not used for training, vocabulary, or corpus choices.
purpose: In all three eval negation cases the correct word is also the most recent candidate, so 'copy the latest matching word' passes them. Here the correct word comes first and the negated word comes last, so that shortcut picks the wrong answer.

groups.recency_trap: Correct word first, negated word most recent

scoring: Same as evals/language_evals.json: highest probability among four single-token choices.
